parameters.name: EffectCount
parameters.description:
The limit on the number of logons allowed. Valid values:

- **0**: No limit on the number of logons. The O&M engineer can log on an unlimited number of times during the validity period.

- **1**: The O&M engineer can log on only once during the validity period.
> - The logon limit for database asset O&M approval can only be set to unlimited.
> - If an empty character string is passed, the default value is unlimited.

parameters.name: EffectEndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the validity period for logon (in seconds, UNIX timestamp format).

parameters.name: EffectStartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the validity period for logon (in seconds, UNIX timestamp format).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: OperationTicketId
parameters.description:
The ID of the O&M request to approve.
> You can call the [ListOperationTickets](~~2584313~~) operation to query all OperationTicketId values that require approval.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
